title: Extraction: full loads, incremental loads and watermarks

videos.script: Every night the shop's orders table is a little longer. Copying all of it to find one day of news gets worse every night. {{full}} So Ana asks the shop a narrower question. Which rows changed since I last looked? {{incremental}} The answer depends on one column, updated at. And on one number she keeps: the newest change she has already loaded. That number is the watermark. {{watermark}} Night one reads seventeen thousand rows. Night two reads two hundred and sixty-one. {{nights}} Then a card machine hangs at twenty to midnight. The order is written before the watermark, and committed after it. {{late}} No night will ever ask for it. {{gap}} And on the fourteenth, a customer asks to be forgotten. Their row is deleted. A deleted row has no updated at, because it has no row. {{delete}} This lesson finds both holes, and closes them.
